caption:
Your heart has a cure, and it came from Allah

Allah describes what He sent to us: an exhortation from our Lord, a cure for what is in the hearts, guidance and mercy for the believers. Start this Friday by reading a few verses of it.

Surah Yunus 10:57

Save this for the morning your heart feels heavy.

#quranhealing #healingverses #surahyunus #fridayreminder

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
